description: This Java source file defines the SystemConfigurationController class, which handles web requests for viewing and saving system configurations within an admin interface of a web application. It interacts with merchant configuration services and manages UI menu states.

classes.name: SystemConfigurationController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller that manages system configuration settings in the admin interface, providing endpoints to display and save system configurations.

methods.name: displaySysyemConfgurations
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display current system configurations for a merchant store.

methods.name: saveSystemConfigurations
methods.description: Processes POST requests to save updated system configuration settings for a merchant store.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets the menu context in the model to help render the correct menu in the UI.
